# Azeroth Creature Compendium

[![WoW Forever](https://img.shields.io/badge/WoW_Forever-1.60.1-blue.svg)](https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/)
[![Zero Taint](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-Zero_Taint-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/bguerre20/AzerothCreatureCompendium/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
[![Architecture](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docs-Architecture_Specification-informational.svg)](https://github.com/bguerre20/AzerothCreatureCompendium/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-lightgrey.svg)](https://github.com/bguerre20/AzerothCreatureCompendium/blob/main/LICENSE)

**A personal creature journal and Pokédex for World of Warcraft Forever.**

**Azeroth Creature Compendium (ACC)** records information about the creatures you encounter as you explore, fight, and loot:
- **Creature Info**: Level ranges, creature family (Beast, Humanoid, Undead, Dragonkin, etc.), open-world zones and dungeons, local subzones, and rare/elite classification. Map coordinates are saved for rare spawns.
- **Spells & Abilities**: Spells cast by each mob, tracked with spell icons, school colors, and cast counts.
- **Immunities**: Tracks creature immunities observed during combat, including spell schools (*Fire, Frost, Nature, Shadow, Arcane, Holy, Physical*) and mechanics (*Taunt, Bleed, Stun, Polymorph, Fear, Snare/Root, Silence, Sleep, Poison*) without using restricted combat log events.
- **Loot & Drop Rates**: Item drop percentages, sample sizes (e.g., `4/28 drops`), empty loot counts, and average coin dropped.
- **Profession Harvesting**: Separate tracking for Skinning, Mining, Herbalism, and Engineering corpse gathers with harvest counts and drop rates.

---

> ### Core Philosophy: Journey Before Destination
> This addon is developed with the core gameplay pillar of **Journey Before Destination**. While there may be many addons out there that have all this information baked in, and you can absolutely Google this and get all the answers on Wowhead, I felt that in the spirit of the game I wanted something that feels like an explorer's journal you are appending to as you play. You may not have all the info today, but if you keep playing you will keep accruing it and you can reference your personal compendium at any time.

---

## Features

### 1. Creature Tooltips (Sidecars or Embedded)
- **Three Data Sections:**
  - **Loot Drops (Default: `[SHIFT]`):** Item drop list, drop rates, sample sizes, and average coin.
  - **Combat Profile (Default: `[CTRL]`):** Level range, classification, recorded immunities, and spells cast.
  - **Profession Loot (Default: `[ALT]`):** Gathered corpse loot (Skinning, Mining, Herbalism, Engineering) with drop rates and skill tags.
- **Activation Modes:** Set each section independently to require a hotkey (`SHIFT`, `CTRL`, `ALT`), `ALWAYS` show on mouseover, or `NEVER` show.
- **Layout & Positioning:**
  - **Sidecar Mode (`SIDECAR`):** Attach companion tooltips horizontally beside or vertically above/below the main tooltip.
  - **Embedded Mode (`EMBEDDED`):** Append creature data directly inside Blizzard's default `GameTooltip`.
  - **Anchor Point:** Attach tooltips to Blizzard's main tooltip or follow the mouse cursor.
- **New Creature Indicator:** Shows a brief prompt on attackable enemy creature tooltips when you encounter an undocumented mob for the first time (can be toggled off in settings or via `/acc newmob`).

### 2. Compendium Browser (`/acc`)
- **Zone & Creature List:** Searchable list of discovered open-world zones, dungeons, and creatures. Hover over any zone or dungeon to view how many creatures and research ranks you have recorded there.
- **Creature Entry Card:**
  - **3D Model Preview:** Interactive creature model with click-and-drag rotation.
  - **Bestiary Ranks:** Creatures gain research ranks as you kill, loot, and harvest them, progressing from *Safari Greenhorn* to *Nesingwary's Apprentice*, *Master of the Hunt*, and *The Hemetinator*.
  - **Subzone Locations (`Found in:`):** Lists the local subzones where you have spotted each creature (for example, *Coldridge Valley and Kharanos*).
  - **Combat & Abilities Tab:** Lists recorded immunities and spells cast by the creature. Hover over any spell to view its Blizzard spell tooltip.
  - **Loot Table Tab:** Shows total looted corpses, empty loots, average coin, and item drop rates. Shift-click any item to link it in chat.
  - **Professions Tab:** Lists corpse gathering yields for Skinning, Mining, Herbalism, and Engineering.
- **Search Filter:** Filter the compendium by zone, subzone, creature name, spell, loot item, or profession material.

### 3. Minimap Button
- **Left-Click:** Open the Compendium window.
- **Right-Click:** Open Addon Settings.
- **Left-Drag:** Reposition around the minimap border.
- **Addon Compatibility:** Works with minimap button managers, square minimaps, and LibDataBroker display bars (such as Leatrix Plus and MinimapButtonBag).

---

## Slash Commands

Use `/acc`, `/compendium`, `/pokedex`, or the legacy aliases `/bgl` and `/bgloot`:

| Command | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/acc` | Toggle the Compendium browser window |
| `/acc options` | Open the Interface Settings panel |
| `/acc minimap` | Toggle the minimap button |
| `/acc status` | Print database totals in chat |
| `/acc lootkey <SHIFT\|CTRL\|ALT\|ALWAYS\|NEVER>` | Set activation mode for the Loot tooltip |
| `/acc combatkey <SHIFT\|CTRL\|ALT\|ALWAYS\|NEVER>` | Set activation mode for the Combat tooltip |
| `/acc profkey <SHIFT\|CTRL\|ALT\|ALWAYS\|NEVER>` | Set activation mode for the Profession tooltip |
| `/acc layout <sidecar\|embedded>` | Switch between sidecar tooltips and the embedded tooltip |
| `/acc dock <beside\|above>` | Position sidecar tooltips beside or above/below the main tooltip |
| `/acc anchor <tooltip\|cursor>` | Anchor tooltips to the main tooltip or mouse cursor |
| `/acc newmob` | Toggle tooltip info on unrecorded creatures |
| `/acc debug` | Toggle debug mode (show raw Lua errors vs fail-safe suppression) |
| `/acc max <1-25>` | Set the maximum number of items shown in tooltips |
| `/acc lookup <name>` | Search for a recorded creature in chat |
| `/acc reset confirm` | Clear all recorded compendium data |

---

## Data Migration & Technical Documentation

- **BgLootLogger Migration:** Existing `BgLootLoggerDB` saved data is automatically imported into `AzerothCreatureCompendiumDB` on first load.
- **Architecture & Development Docs:** For event flows, database schema details, and contributor guidelines, see [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/bguerre20/AzerothCreatureCompendium/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

releases.notes:
# Azeroth Creature Compendium

## v1.0.0 (2026-11-08)
- Promoted Azeroth Creature Compendium from beta to full release (`v1.0.0`) for the World of Warcraft Forever launch.
- Includes all features and stability fixes from the beta testing cycle:
  - Compendium browser (`/acc`) with 3D creature models, zone and dungeon lists, subzone locations, and search filtering.
  - Creature research ranks (*Safari Greenhorn* through *The Hemetinator*) with medallion and portrait icons.
  - Loot, Combat, and Profession tooltip sections supporting Sidecar or Embedded layouts, customizable hotkeys (`Shift`, `Ctrl`, `Alt`, `Always`, `Never`), and cursor or tooltip anchoring.
  - Zero-taint combat tracking for enemy spells and immunities using standard unit and UI events.
  - Automatic inactivity in PvP battlegrounds and arenas, plus safe handling of restricted unit values inside instances.

## v0.10.6-beta (2026-10-15)
- Fixed a bug where destroying enemy totems, wards (such as Murloc Healing Wards), or secondary targets mid-combat without looting them did not always count as a kill.
- Added a check so creatures tapped by other players are not counted toward your kill total.

## v0.10.5-beta (2026-10-15)
- Fixed a Lua error when hovering over creatures inside dungeons and battlegrounds.
- Disabled all addon activity while inside PvP battlegrounds and arenas.
- Added dungeon zone detection so creatures looted inside dungeons are recorded under the dungeon name instead of Unknown Zone.
- Added a tooltip notice when WoW addon API restrictions block unit information inside instances.
- Added a fail-safe mode that suppresses unexpected API restriction errors by default, with a Debug Mode toggle in the Options panel and `/acc debug` slash command.

## v0.10.4-beta (2026-10-14)
- Fixed the minimap button appearing as a blank white circle when used with minimap addons such as Leatrix Plus and MinimapButtonBag.
- Added support for square minimaps and LibDataBroker display bars.

## v0.10.3-beta (2026-10-14)
- Added a setting in the Options panel and `/acc newmob` slash command to hide tooltip info on unrecorded creatures.
- Fixed creature tooltips so friendly NPCs, unattackable NPCs, pets, and critters are ignored.

## v0.10.2-beta (2026-10-03)
- Fixed a Lua error when zoning into dungeons caused by restricted nameplate identifiers.

## v0.10.1-beta (2026-10-02)
- Added medallion and portrait icons to creature research ranks on Pokédex cards and zone tooltips.
- Added automated release publishing to both CurseForge and GitHub Releases.

## v0.10.0-beta (2026-10-02)
- Added subzone tracking to record the local areas where each creature is found (e.g., Coldridge Valley or Kharanos within Dun Morogh).
- Added a "Found in:" line on creature cards showing recorded subzones.
- Added subzone matching to the Compendium search bar.

## v0.9.7-beta (2026-10-02)
- Fixed Lua errors when nearby enemies cast spells with protected client values.
- Added fallback handling so restricted enemy abilities are grouped under `Unknown (Protected Ability)` instead of causing errors.
- Added automatic cleanup for placeholder spell names once out of combat.

## v0.9.6-beta (2026-10-02)
- Added Bestiary research ranks (*Safari Greenhorn* through *The Hemetinator*) that progress as you kill, loot, and harvest creatures.
- Added zone progression tooltips when hovering over zones in the Compendium list.
- Simplified tooltip headers to *Compendium - Loot*, *Compendium - Combat*, and *Compendium - Professions*.

## v0.9.5-beta (2026-10-02)
- Fixed a bug where looting a corpse counted as an extra kill.
- Fixed an issue that prevented `/acc` and `/compendium` slash commands from working.
- Fixed `/acc status` inflating the total harvest count when run multiple times.

## v0.9.4-beta (2026-10-01)
- Added an Embedded tooltip mode to show creature data directly inside Blizzard's default tooltip.
- Added `Always` and `Never` display options for Loot, Combat, and Profession tooltip sections alongside `Shift`, `Ctrl`, and `Alt`.
- Added an option to stack sidecar tooltips vertically (above/below) or horizontally (beside).
- Added an option to anchor tooltips to the mouse cursor.
- Added `/acc anchor`, `/acc layout`, and `/acc dock` slash commands.
- Adjusted button font size and padding in the Options panel so labels fit cleanly.

## v0.9.1-beta (2026-10-01)
- Added a tooltip indicator when encountering an undocumented creature for the first time.
- Improved account-wide database loading across characters.
- Added a setting to show or hide tooltip hotkey hints.

## v0.9.0-beta (2026-10-01)
- Added the Compendium browser window (`/acc`) with 3D creature models, zone lists, loot tables, abilities, and immunities.
- Added combat tracking for enemy spells and immunities using standard unit and UI events.
- Added loot and profession gathering tracking (Skinning, Mining, Herbalism, Engineering).
- Added companion tooltips for loot, combat, and profession data.
- Added a draggable minimap button.
